title: Gybolg
summary: Gybolg is a fierce Gaia-Titan from the stories of Celtic Ireland who belonged to the fierce dog warrior, Cú Chulainn. Gybolg's name means "barbed spear" and represents the strength of earth and the swiftness of water. He wields a mighty sword and can summon forest minions named Calbolg to fight by his side.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
In ancient times, Gybolg was used by the fierce dog warrior, Cú Chulainn. Scarlet Byrne theorized that Cú Chulainn had to defeat a water Titan or clear a water trap in order to find his Gybolg's Amulet. His Amulet was eventually left in the Newgrange Passage Tomb in Ireland. [Home Turf]

Years later, Scarlet, with the help of Dante´s team, managed to locate and bond with this Titan. Gybolg was then invoked to fight alongside Dante's team aginst Klaus' Suits and defeat one of their Bonelasher Titans. [Home Turf]

Scarlet invoked Gybolg after she was ambushed by Firbolg the fierce giant whilst searching for Tír na nÓg, the magical floating castle. After enduring some hits, Gybolg was able to demobilize Firbolg and defeat him. [Back Home]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
When Gybolg starts a combat his attack power increases, thanks to his Berserker ability. Gybolg can also use his mighty sword to slice through enemies. Gybolg can use some of his strength to call his minions, [[Calbolg]]s to raise an army to fight with him, an ability he shares in common with [[Bazela's Hive]] and [[Ymir]]. He is also fairly durable.

* Gybolg's name is derived from [[wikipedia:Gáe Bulg|Gáe Bulg]], a legendary spear used by [[wikipedia:Cú Chulainn|Cú Chulainn]]. Gybolg's appearance is based off of a being from English Folklore called the [[wikipedia:Green Man|Green Man]].
